subject: Castle of Ordeal
text: The Castle of Ordeal contains a treasure chest holding the TAIL to the right near a sofa.

evidence.quote: Anyway, go to the right, and you will see a treasure chest and a sofa.  Get the treasure chest from the bottom.  It's the TAIL!!!

subject: Zombie Dragon
text: Zombie Dragon attacks physically and can be defeated using regular attacks and Harm spells.

evidence.quote:
Contrary to most bosses,  
Zombie D can't do anything other than attack, and that he doesn't even do that 
well.  Rather than use tough boss strategy, just attack and use Harm spells.

subject: Bahamut
text: Bahamut is located on the Cardia Islands in the bottom-right hole on the forest-covered island with 2 holes.

evidence.quote:
He is located on the Cardia 
Islands, which is a rather simple maze.  To get to him, find the island with 2 
holes that's covered with forest.  His hole is on the bottom right of this 
island.

subject: ProRing
text: ProRings can be purchased in Gaia to protect characters against RUB and similar spells.

evidence.quote:
First, head to Gaia.  That's the town 
in the upper right corner of the map, surrounded by mountains, northeast of the 
Mirage Desert.  You should buy ProRings for everyone, as they prevent RUB and 
like spells.

subject: Lost L8 Magics shop
text: A semi-secret passage through a notch in the upper right town gates of Lefien leads to two shops selling the Level 8 spells LIF2 and NUKE.

evidence.quote:
As if it's a big secret, there is a semi-secret 
passage in Lefien that leads to the 2 "best" magic spells in the game.  If you 
go to Lefien, go to the upper right section of town.  There will be a notch in 
the town gates for you to walk through.  Go to the right to find 2 small shops 
right next to each other... The LOST L8 MAGICS!  The White side has LIF2 and the 
Black Side has NUKE.

subject: CUR4
text: The Level 7 White Wizard spell CUR4 restores HP to maximum as long as the recipient is not stoned or dead.

evidence.quote:
Well, the White Wizard 
will definitely want CUR4, which you've been waiting the whole game for.  
This spell restores your HP to the Max, no questions asked as long as you're not 
stoned or dead.

subject: ICE3
text: The Level 7 spell ICE3 can deal up to 240 damage to all enemies.

evidence.quote:
Well, ICE3 is 
really nothing new, only it's very powerful.  I think it can do up to 240 damage 
to all enemies, and even more than that if they're weak against it.

subject: LIF2
text: The Level 8 White Wizard spell LIF2 revives a dead warrior to full health.

evidence.quote: LIF2 will revive a dead warrior to full health, no questions asked.

subject: FADE
text: The White Wizard spell FADE can deal up to a little over 300 damage per monster and hits any enemy.

evidence.quote:
FADE is an excellent spell.  It can do up to a little over 300 damage per 
monster, and unlike HARM, works on any enemy, not just undead.

subject: NUKE
text: The Level 8 Black Wizard spell Nuke can deal up to 400 damage.

evidence.quote:
Nuke packs a mean punch up to 400 damage, but I thought that's what 
your Knights and Masters were for.
